## Code

[**VBC**](https://github.com/henrifnk/VBC) — Vine copula bias correction for climate data; corrects the multivariate distribution of heavy-tailed, zero-inflated and continuous climate variables. Accompanies the JRSS-C paper above.

[**FACT**](https://github.com/henrifnk/FACT) — Feature Attributions for Clustering; transfers algorithm-agnostic interpretability methods to clustering tasks. Accompanies the xAI 2023 paper above. (Formerly on CRAN; source now maintained on GitHub.)

[**FuzzyDBScan**](https://github.com/henrifnk/FuzzyDBScan) — Fuzzy clustering with DBScan. (Formerly on CRAN; source now maintained on GitHub.)

Find the most up-to-date list on [ResearchGate](https://www.researchgate.net/profile/Henri-Funk). A few of the contributions here fall outside climate science — they come out of my work advising researchers through [StaBLab](https://www.stat.lmu.de/stablab/en/), LMU's statistical consulting unit.
